findings: VSI-REQ-01: R_TASK expressly requires data leakage as well as adaptive overfitting. Item 6 names adaptive reuse, reference errors, reward exploitation and metric conflicts but leaves leakage unassigned. This is not merely another name for repeated selection: VSI001 original.txt, Appendix C.3 (around lines 1035-1038), says the private test patch is included in the diagnosis prompt and reports manual inspection as reassurance; its Polyglot discussion (line 111) separately discusses possible foundation-model benchmark exposure. These are relevant information-access and contamination boundaries that a transfer label alone does not settle. Add a compact planned comparison of what test/task information reaches the generator/diagnoser, what is protected, and what public evidence can establish about leakage, without demanding a new experiment or treating possible leakage as proven invalidity.
